text: {"lessons":["My account has recovered from its early decline and is now above its Period 2 value, but that does not guarantee future gains; I should keep prioritizing stability over chasing returns.","Selling Stock D and Stock A at gains did not prevent a small account decline the next period, so I should not assume a profitable sale or a short-term price move predicts what comes next.","As a retired investor who relies on these savings, I should make deliberate decisions, keep enough cash for living needs, and avoid letting any one holding create more risk than I can tolerate."]}
